issues.detail: The Write/Edit trigger fires on the role's first write of its synchronization record. The skill tells the role to create the record early, so the guide may change before reconciliation is finished rather than 'immediately before writing the conclusion'. A correct run must still detect the change, either during reconciliation or at the final identity recheck. The judge should credit detection at either point. No better trigger exists in the midRunEdits vocabulary.
issues.fix: Accept the approximation. graderOnly already explains when the change fires.

issues.detail: The Bash trigger regex `(>|\btee\b).*\.standards/docs/synchronization/` also matches exploratory chains that contain an earlier redirect followed by a mention of the folder. For example, `node .standards/bin/artifact.mjs init SYNCHRONIZATION 2>&1 && cat .standards/docs/synchronization/…` matches, and so does `git status 2>&1; ls .standards/docs/synchronization/`. Such commands could fire the edit before any record write.
issues.fix: In synchronizer-42/spec.json, change runtime.midRunEdits[1].after.command so the redirect target itself is the record path: `(>>?|\btee(\s+-a)?)\s*['\"]?(\./)?\.standards/docs/synchronization/`.

summary: The base already provides the exact SYNCHRONIZING starting state with consistent records and a clean tree. The midRunEdits replacement introduces a material, Documenter-owned guide change that contradicts AC-002 and is not covered by the blob-cited final review. The checks for assertion 1 (record exists, not COMPLETE, no sign-off state) hold under every correct outcome, and the invariants fit; only minor timing notes on the mid-run trigger remain.
